likely_causes.cause: nonphysical normalization or GUI Abs(T)^2 interpretation
monitor placement or source normalization issue
unconverged numerical artifact

diagnostics.symptom: peak disappears or shifts strongly when mesh changes

likely_causes.cause: mesh-dependent geometry discretization
resonance created by numerical artifact
insufficient min mesh around high-index or metal aperture

required_actions: add local mesh only if physically justified

diagnostics.symptom: background oscillations or many side peaks

likely_causes.cause: Fabry-Perot reflections from domain or substrate
multiple resonant modes in band
source bandwidth or simulation time artifacts

required_actions: inspect field maps of side peaks

diagnostics.symptom: field peak wavelength matches transmission but field map is at monitor boundary only

likely_causes.cause: field monitor placed in wrong plane
direct transmission channel instead of cavity resonance

required_actions: place field monitor in resonator mid-plane
do not claim mechanism from boundary field only

diagnostics.symptom: peak high but offband p95 rises

likely_causes.cause: overcoupling/direct leakage channel
metal aperture too large
symmetry breaking too strong

diagnostics.symptom: field map cannot explain proposed mode

likely_causes.cause: wrong physical mechanism selected
field monitor plane misses the mode maximum
spectrum not converged
long-lived high-Q tail not sufficiently decayed
mesh override changed metal/slit discretization and excited numerical ringing
current geometry is too mesh-sensitive for acceptance

required_actions: prefer geometry simplification or switch mechanism

uncertain_experience_policy.rule: Keep uncertain observations but do not use them as hard design rules until confirmed by convergence and field-map consistency.
